title: The internal hom of presheaves of modules commutes with limits and the internal hom of sheaves does too
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file sites-modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for presheaves of modules the internal hom functor commutes with arbitrary limits in either variable, and that the same holds for sheaves of modules. The proof takes a diagram of presheaves, evaluates at an object U, and uses that the restriction functor to the localized category is both a left and a right adjoint, so it preserves limits; the computation of sections of the internal hom then turns the claim into the defining property of a limit, and the second statement follows by the same computation (proof lines 4103-4132). The sheaf statement is deduced from the presheaf one because the limit of a diagram of sheaves is computed as a sheaf and the internal hom of sheaves is the sheafification of the presheaf internal hom. H2: the sectionwise computation using the two-sided adjointness of restriction is the substance.
